fact: The government plans to introduce a draft Child Registration Act in the upcoming parliamentary session to empower NIDA to register children from birth, as announced by NIDA's Director General; the document gives no bill number.

An Infant Registration Bill is to be tabled in Parliament's next session starting 27 January 2026, under which children would be registered at birth with a unique identification number leading to a national digital ID card at 18, per NIDA's Director General.

The government is preparing to table the Infant Registration Bill in the next Parliament, which would let NIDA register children from birth and assign identification numbers, with national ID cards issued on the same numbers at 18; the bill was not yet tabled.
